```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
echo = TRUE,
message = FALSE,
warning = FALSE,
33
error = FALSE,
fig.align = "center",
fig.width = 8,
fig.height = 4
)

paquetes <- c(
"tidyverse", "readr", "readxl", "haven", "jsonlite",
"lubridate", "hms", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr",
"GGally", "car", "dbplyr", "RColorBrewer"
)
for (p in paquetes) {
if (!require(p, character.only = TRUE)) {
install.packages(p)
library(p, character.only = TRUE)
}
}
```
